source_title: India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 19 Posts - FreeJobAlert.Com
source_excerpt:
India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026: The Department of Posts, Mail Motor Services (MMS), Kolkata, has issued a corrigendum dated 29 October 2026 , inviting applications for 19 Skilled Artisan / Tradesman posts in seven trades, including MV Mechanic, MV Electrician, Tyreman, Blacksmith, Painter, Upholsterer and Carpenter & Joiner. Candidates with a Government-recognized trade certificate or 8th Pass qualification with one year of relevant trade experience can apply. The pay scale is Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200 under Level 2 of the 7th CPC. Applications must reach the designated Kolkata office through Speed Post only by 30 November 2026, 5:00 PM .
India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 - Overview
Important: This is a corrigendum to the earlier recruitment notification dated 19 May 2020. Applications submitted against the earlier notices dated 8 August 2018 and 19 May 2020 will also be considered. Fresh candidates may apply, and previously applied candidates may submit an updated application showing their trade preferences.
India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
The completed application must reach the Senior Manager, Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, by the deadline. The notice does not specify a separate application start date.
Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, has announced 19 vacancies across seven skilled trades . MV Mechanic has the highest number of vacancies with eight posts.
India Post Skilled Artisan Category-Wise Vacancies
Ex-Servicemen Reservation: Two MV Mechanic vacancies are earmarked for Ex-Servicemen. These are horizontal reservations included within the eight MV Mechanic vacancies and must not be added separately to the total.
India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
Candidates must possess a recognized certificate in the relevant trade or have passed 8th standard with at least one year of experience in that trade. MV Mechanic applicants must additionally hold a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle driving licence.
Important: The notification provides two alternative educational qualification routes. Candidates who possess a recognized trade certificate need not assume that the one-year experience condition automatically applies to their route. However, supporting documents must be furnished for the eligibility route claimed.
Candidates applying for the MV Mechanic trade must possess a valid HMV driving licence to drive vehicles for testing purposes. The application must include a self-attested copy of the licence or licence extract.
The HMV driving licence requirement applies specifically to MV Mechanic and is not stated as a general condition for all seven trades.
India Post Skilled Artisan Age Limit 2026
The corrigendum retains an age limit of 18 to 30 years as on 1 July 2018 for unreserved candidates. This historical cut-off date is explicitly stated in the notification and must not be replaced with a 2026 date.
For Ex-Servicemen, the notification provides relaxation after deduction of qualifying military service in the Motor Vehicle Mechanic trade from actual age. The additional relaxation is up to three years for UR, six years for OBC and eight years for SC/ST candidates, under the stated conditions.
SC/ST/OBC-NCL age relaxation applies in respect of vacancies reserved for the respective category.
The Skilled Artisan posts carry a pay scale of Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200 under Level 2 of the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix, plus admissible allowances.
The notified pay scale is not an in-hand salary figure. Actual monthly pay will depend on applicable allowances and deductions.
India Post Skilled Artisan Application Fee 2026
The corrigendum dated 29 October 2026 does not specify an application fee amount or separate fee payment procedure.
Candidates should not assume an application fee or exemption unless it is confirmed by the applicable official recruitment instructions.
India Post Skilled Artisan Selection Process 2026
Selection will be made through a Competitive Trade Test based on the syllabus of the respective trade. Applications will first be examined against the prescribed qualifications and supporting documents.
Scrutiny of applications and eligibility documents.
Shortlisting of eligible candidates for the trade test.
Competitive Trade Test in the respective trade.
Selection based on the prescribed qualification, experience, category-wise vacancies and trade test performance.
The syllabus, test date, venue and duration will be communicated to eligible candidates through their Hall Permits. The notification does not specify a common written examination pattern or total marks for the trade test.
Important: Meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee a call for the trade test. The department will not entertain correspondence regarding rejected applications.
India Post Skilled Artisan Apply Offline 2026
Eligible candidates must submit their application in the prescribed format through Speed Post only . Applications sent by courier or other transmission methods will not be considered.
To, The Senior Manager, Mail Motor Services, 139, Beleghata Road, Kolkata - 700015.
Last Date for Receipt: 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM.
Important: Candidates applying for multiple trades must send separate applications in separate envelopes. Each envelope must clearly mention the trade applied for.
How to Apply for India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026?
Visit the official India Post website at www.indiapost.gov.in .
Refer to the Skilled Artisan / Tradesman corrigendum issued by Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, dated 29 October 2026.
Read the eligibility criteria, category-wise vacancies, driving licence requirements and application instructions.
Obtain the prescribed application format included on page 4 of the notification.
Print the form and enter the trade name, personal information, category, contact details, date of birth, educational qualifications and technical experience.
Enter driving licence details if applying for MV Mechanic.
Affix one recent passport-size photograph in the designated space and self-attest it.
Attach self-attested photocopies of the required educational, technical, identity, experience and category documents.
Place the application and supporting documents in an envelope and write "Application for the post of / Name of Trade: [Trade Name]" on the envelope.
Send the envelope through Speed Post only to the Senior Manager, Mail Motor Services, 139, Beleghata Road, Kolkata - 700015.
Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 30 November 2026 at 5:00 PM .
Note for Previous Applicants: Candidates who already applied under the 2018 or 2020 notifications will be considered. The department states that submitting a fresh application mentioning the current trade preference is preferable. If multiple applications are received from the same candidate, only the latest will be considered.
Documents Required for India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026
Applicants must attach self-attested photocopies of the documents applicable to their qualification and reservation claims.
Age proof, such as Birth Certificate, Class 10 Certificate or School Leaving Certificate.
Indian citizenship proof, such as Passport, Voter ID, Birth Certificate, Domicile or other acceptable Government-issued document.
Relevant trade or technical qualification certificate, such as ITI, where applicable.
HMV Driving Licence or licence extract for MV Mechanic applicants.
One-year trade experience certificate, where applicable, showing the organization's name and complete postal address.
Valid SC/ST/OBC-NCL/Ex-Serviceman certificate, if claiming the corresponding benefit.
Two recent self-attested passport-size photographs, one affixed to the form and another attached separately.
Important: Do not send original certificates. Experience certificates without the organization's complete postal address may result in rejection. Reservation certificates must be in the prescribed format applicable to Central Government recruitment.
India Post Skilled Artisan Application Rejection Conditions
Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, may reject applications that do not comply with the prescribed submission and eligibility requirements.
Application submitted through courier or a mode other than Speed Post.
Application for multiple trades in one form or envelope.
Missing prescribed qualification, experience or valid HMV licence for MV Mechanic.
Experience certificate without the organization's full postal address.
Missing valid community certificate where required.
Incorrectly addressed application or envelope.
Damaged or mutilated application documents.
Application received after 30 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Applicants should verify the completed form and all attachments before dispatch. The notification states that applications may be rejected without separate intimation.
India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
The corrigendum relates to earlier recruitment notices dated 8 August 2018 and 19 May 2020.
Applications previously submitted against those notices will remain under consideration.
Fresh candidates satisfying the eligibility conditions may also apply.
Where multiple applications are received from one candidate, only the latest application will be considered.
The age calculation date remains 1 July 2018.
Separate forms and envelopes are required for different trades.
Applications must be sent through Speed Post only.
Original certificates must not be enclosed.
No TA/DA will be paid for attending the trade test.
The advertised vacancies may change, and the issuing authority reserves the right to modify or cancel the notification.
In case of a discrepancy, the English version of the notification will prevail.
India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, issued the Skilled Artisan Recruitment Corrigendum under Notification No. MMG/36/Sk. Artisan/DR/II/95 on 29 October 2026.
The 12-page bilingual notice contains the trade-wise and category-wise vacancy distribution, qualification requirements, age relaxation, selection process, application conditions, prescribed application form and caste certificate formats.

India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 - FAQs
Q1. How many vacancies are available in India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026?
The Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, corrigendum announces 19 Skilled Artisan / Tradesman vacancies across seven trades.
Q2. What is the last date to apply for India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026?
The completed application must reach Mail Motor Services, Kolkata, through Speed Post by 30 November 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Q3. Can 8th Pass candidates apply for India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026?
Yes. Candidates who passed 8th standard and have one year of experience in the respective trade can apply. Alternatively, candidates with a Government-recognized certificate in the relevant trade can satisfy the notified qualification requirement.
Q4. What is the age limit for India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026?
The age limit for unreserved candidates is 18 to 30 years as on 1 July 2018, with applicable relaxation for eligible categories.
Q5. What is the salary for India Post Skilled Artisan posts?
The pay scale is Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200 under Level 2 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, plus admissible allowances.
Q6. Is an HMV driving licence required for all Skilled Artisan posts?
No. A valid HMV driving licence is specifically required for the MV Mechanic trade.
Q7. Can candidates who applied in 2018 or 2020 apply again?
Yes. Previous applications will be considered, but the corrigendum states that a fresh application indicating the current trade preference is preferable. If multiple applications are submitted, only the latest will be considered.
Q8. What is the selection process for India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026?
Selection will be through a Competitive Trade Test for eligible candidates. The syllabus, date, venue and duration will be communicated with the Hall Permits.
Q9. Can the application be submitted online?
No. The notification requires offline submission by Speed Post only. Applications sent by courier or other methods will not be accepted.
